hedgeCoverageRatio.rationale: Documented-policy figure only: Neutrl states collateral is deployed into delta-neutral, duration-matched strategies and NUSD is backed by crypto assets / liquid synthetic dollars and corresponding short futures. No position-level net delta or hedge-notional inventory is published on Accountable or elsewhere; JLP (16.2% of reserves at pin) and OTC Aggregate (17.0%) hedge completeness is unverified at the pin.

marginBufferPct.rationale: System reserve excess over supply from Accountable, not per-venue exchange margin headroom. (total_reserves 61504400.34 / total_supply 59101340.35 - 1) * 100 = 4.065999. Venue-level maintenance-margin utilization is unpublished.

lossAbsorptionShare.rationale: Proxy = measured reserve excess over supply (0.04066). Neutrl docs mention a reserve fund capitalized from protocol revenue for negative-funding and margin support, but Accountable does not itemize a separate insurance/reserve-fund balance distinct from total reserves; no junior tranche or explicit first-loss pool is published. Do not invent a reserve-fund size.

fundingBasisStress.basis: PRIMARY (re-opened 2026-07-27): Neutrl Funding Risks documents an actionable stress design — dynamic TVL reallocation between OTC and funding-arbitrage sleeves (and into yield-bearing stablecoins under market stress), a reserve fund capitalized from positive-funding revenue to absorb negative-funding periods, real-time cross-exchange funding monitoring with dynamic position adjustment, and optional calendar-futures hedges for funding exposure. CORROBORATION (independent): (1) Accountable live type/venue splits at pin show material CEX concentration (Bybit 38.74% of reserves) consistent with active funding/perp venue dependence, plus liquid Stablecoin sleeve 58.2% as a reallocation destination; (2) Serenity Research (Dec 2025, independent) independently describes Neutrl revenue as including basis/funding-rate hedges (spot-perp or perp-perp) and OTC locked tokens hedged in perps markets. Grade limited not adequate: mitigations are issuer policy prose plus dashboard structure; no published quantitative funding-stress scenario outputs, historical funding PnL series, or independently examined reserve-fund balance dedicated to negative-funding absorption.

marginAndLiquidation.basis: PRIMARY (re-opened 2026-07-27): Neutrl Margin Risks documents leverage limits with margin utilization 'well below' exchange maxima, real-time multi-exchange margin monitoring, automated alerts at a stated 50% utilization threshold, automated collateral top-ups (manual fallback), multi-exchange diversification, regular stress tests (price crash / cascading liquidation / low-liquidity slippage scenarios), proactive position reduction in abnormal markets, a liquid-stablecoin-funded reserve fund for margin bolstering, and 24/7 trading coverage. CORROBORATION (independent): Accountable reserves_split at pin shows multi-venue exchange exposure (Bybit 38.74%, Binance 4.78%, OKX 0.32%) plus measured system overcollateralization of 4.07% (reserves $61,504,400.34 vs supply $59,101,340.35); Cube Exchange secondary risk write-up (Apr 2026, citing the 4pillars Neutrl risk-architecture review) independently frames forced deleveraging / exchange-margin outages as material failure modes for the model. On-chain eth_call totalSupply() at block 25627233 returned 58,843,762.36 NUSD (0.44% below Accountable supply — timing/coverage gap noted, not used to invent a different buffer). Grade limited not adequate: no published per-venue maintenance-margin utilization, liquidation-threshold compliance proof, or reserve-fund size separate from aggregate OC; Bybit concentration (~39%) undercuts the diversification claim; Accountable is issuer-designated ZK attestation infrastructure, not a full independent margin audit.
